in_sanskrit.name: Romil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Romil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Romil is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for the Lord of the Gods. This powerful name is a combination of the words 'Rama' and 'Mila', meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. It is a name that embodies strength, wisdom, and courage, and is often given to babies as a sign of devotion and respect.
